context_summary: F57 adds quality-of-life features to the level editor: undo/redo stack, rectangular selection tool, copy/paste/delete area, and drag-move entities. Currently the editor has ZERO undo capability — any mistake requires manual rebuilding. These features are essential for creating quality campaign levels efficiently. Backlog item B-08.

options_considered.description: Implement undo/redo as snapshot stack (deep-clone blocks+entities arrays), selection as a new 'select' tool mode with rectangle overlay, copy/paste as clipboard of selected region.
pros: Snapshot-based undo is simple and reliable — no need to track individual operations
Selection tool integrates naturally with existing tool/palette system
cons: Snapshot approach uses more memory than command-based undo for large levels
Max ~50 snapshots should be enough, with oldest dropped

rationale: Snapshot-based undo is the right choice for this editor. Levels are small (typically <500 blocks + <100 entities), so memory is not a concern. The simplicity of deep-cloning state beats the complexity of a command pattern. Selection tool fits naturally into the existing tool system. Copy/paste is just 'store selected region, paste at cursor'.
